subject: Materials Science
title: Monomers: The Building Blocks
description: Learn Monomers: The Building Blocks in one minute.

hook.text: Ethylene is a gas. Link its molecules together and it becomes solid polyethylene.

buildup.text: A monomer is the smallest repeating unit — the single bead on a necklace of thousands.

discovery.text: Different monomers create different polymers — styrene gives polystyrene, propylene gives PP.

twist.text: Mix two different monomers and you get a copolymer with hybrid properties.

climax.text: The monomer you choose decides whether the product is a grocery bag or a bulletproof vest.

punchline.text: Change the monomer, change the world it makes.

quiz.question: What is a copolymer?
options: A polymer made from a single type of monomer
A polymer made from two or more different monomers
A polymer that cannot be recycled
